components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The filled default action: Graphite Ink on Paper.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.205 0 0)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.985 0 0)); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 8px; transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action with hairline border and whisper shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--background, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--accent, oklch(0.97 0 0)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Toolbar and icon actions; invisible until hovered.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 8px; transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--accent, oklch(0.97 0 0)); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Transparent field with hairline stroke; focus is a border shift plus halo.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; width: 100%; padding: 4px 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font-size: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid var(--input, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms, border-color 200ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Card
components.description: The general container: 14px corners, hairline border, whisper shadow.

Run history

narrative.overview: Rova's editor is a cockpit for automation. The chrome recedes into graphite so the workflow graph owns the screen, and every light that comes on means something: a green border is a successful run, a red border is a failure, an animated border is work in progress. The system is built from shadcn/ui (new-york) on Base UI, styled with Tailwind v4 tokens declared in OKLCH, deliberately conventional where convention earns trust.
keyCharacteristics: Achromatic field: every surface, border, and text color is a zero-chroma graphite step.
Color is signal: chroma appears only on run status, destructive actions, and integration icons.
Refined and restrained components: quiet at rest, precise on interaction.
Both themes are first-class; dark mode is a true-black inversion, ink and paper swapped.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Chroma is earned by state. If an element is not communicating run status, a destructive consequence, selection, or an integration's identity, it is grayscale.

rules.name: The One Ramp Rule
rules.body: All neutrals come from the zero-chroma graphite ramp. Never introduce a warm or cool tinted gray.

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: Sizes are fixed rem steps. No clamp(), no fluid type; hierarchy comes from weight and color before size.

rules.name: The Overlay Rule
rules.body: Anything at shadow-lg must be dismissible. If it can't be dismissed, it isn't floating, and it doesn't get the shadow.

dos: Do keep every neutral at zero chroma; the graphite ramp is the entire field.
Do route new status colors through tokens rather than Tailwind palette classes like green-500.
Do hold body and muted text at or above 4.5:1: Graphite Mid is the lightness floor for text on Paper.
Do use the standard component vocabulary everywhere; a save button looks identical on every screen.
Do keep motion in the 150-250ms band, easing out, conveying state.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion with a static alternative for every animation, including the node border sweep.
donts: Don't recreate the colorful n8n/Zapier canvas; integration identity lives in the icon, never in node fills or borders.
Don't introduce SaaS-generic styling: gradient accents, cream-tinted backgrounds, identical marketing card grids.
Don't use color decoratively; if it isn't status, selection, destruction, or an integration icon, it's graphite.
Don't add display fonts, clamp-scaled headings, or letter-spaced uppercase eyebrows.
Don't put shadow-lg on anything that can't be dismissed.
Don't animate layout properties on the canvas; transform and opacity only.
